name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Deliver: Push link coverage toward 100% at +5%/day (the access gate)

name: Reel
text: Do a daily 15-minute manual crawl of the top 20% most-linked pages—those driving 80% of traffic—using the simplest browser extension that logs every link it sees. It’s fast, visible, and gives us immediate coverage gains without touching fragile automation. The trade-off is we miss deep, rare links, but those won’t block the bus task and we can revisit them once the gate is open.

name: Scriv
text: Manual crawl misses the 20% of links that drive the other 20% of traffic—those rare but critical pages break the access gate. Simpler: run a one-time, full-site crawl with a lightweight tool like Screaming Frog, then focus the daily 15-minute crawl on the top 20% to catch fresh additions. Settle it by comparing the cost of a single full crawl against the risk of missing those 20% of links.
